evals.prompt: We just burned two hours on the docs build: on Windows it kept dying with a colorama UnicodeEncodeError until we set PYTHONUTF8=1 and PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8. We also learned that a second `## 2026-06-20` heading in our discovery log silently splits the day block. Before we wrap up, capture what we learned so the next session doesn't hit this again.
evals.expected_output: A routed set of findings: the encoding fix goes to the relevant build skill or its references, the duplicate-date rule goes to the log format or the rules file, and both are recorded as concise symptom-cause-fix bullets in the discovery log under a single date heading. No absolute paths or secrets.

evals.prompt: Before we touch the PHPKB import pipeline again, look at what previous sessions wrote down. Then tell me if anything in the log should move into a skill or rule — don't change anything yet, just show me the proposal.
evals.expected_output: A review of the newest log entries relevant to the import pipeline, followed by a table classifying each candidate as Migrate, Prune, Keep, or Fix with a proposed destination. No files are modified because approval was not given.

evals.prompt: Our AGENTS.md is now 400 lines and half of it is a step-by-step deploy recipe with the same commands repeated. The discovery log also has six bullets about that deploy flow. Can you clean this up?
evals.expected_output: Bloat analysis that proposes extracting the deploy recipe into a new or existing skill, naming the skill and its one-line description, listing which log entries and AGENTS.md sections would move, and asking for approval before creating or editing any file.

evals.prompt: We documented three gotchas on the feature branch and committed the skill updates. The team also maintains platform_v5 and platform_v6. What now?
evals.expected_output: A short handoff note that identifies the documentation commit as portable, distinguishes it from generated/version-specific artifacts, and asks whether to cherry-pick or leave it, without performing any git operation.

evals.prompt: Our discovery log has 180 bullets, including one from June saying the import takes 5–10 minutes and one from July saying 12–15 minutes, and a few entries already marked [superseded by ...]. Refresh it: summarize what should be merged, supersede the stale timeout, and purge what is safe. Show me the plan first.
evals.expected_output: A maintenance proposal table classifying entries as Summarize, Supersede, Purge, Migrate, Keep, or Fix, with evidence for the current timeout, the exact supersession wording and marker, an explicit request for approval, and no file changes before approval.
